what: Each letter is offset 10px up, skewed −10° (skewX) and transparent, then from the first letter on it appears and stands straight at once over 2.4s power3.out while holding 5px of blur (spread .6s), and .3s later the blur clears over 2.4s — the vertical copy on the photo comes into focus. The subpage title type tilts the opposite way (skew 10), stands in 1.1s at .1s intervals, and its 3px blur clears over 2s.

options.on: view (on entering the screen, default) · load (right on attach) · manual (the caller uses el.fxPlay())
options.skew: Initial tilt (degrees), default −10 — subpage titles use 10
options.blur: Blur held at rest (px), default 5 — subpage title 3
options.clear: Blur-clearing duration (seconds), same as default dur — subpage title 2
options.gap: Seconds from the start of standing until the blur begins to clear, default .3
options.each: Gap between letters (sec) — if given, used instead of amount (subpage titles .1)

use: Your quick word here

from.where: index.html .p-home__mvLine (original .js-mvtitle — .5s after the photo starts to clear, y −10 · skewX −10° → 0 · blur 5px 2.4s power3.out spread .6, .3s later blur 0 2.4s) · subpage .nm-umv__title (original .js-undermvtitle — skew: 10; blur: 3; dur: 1.1; clear: 2; each: .1)
